profileLabel: Mixed economics, slight left (medium-low confidence, mostly co-authored)
summary: Rizal 4th District representative with 40 principal-authored bills. Authored free medical check-ups for all and mental health wellness leave for government workers. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a daily wage increase, a universal social pension, cash aid for first-time employees, a medicine voucher program, estate tax abolition and amnesty, income tax restructuring and abolition of the corporate minimum tax.
caveat: Most items are co-authored. Estate-tax and corporate-minimum-tax co-authorships pull right, welfare items pull left; net is modest.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free medical check-ups (-3) and mental health leave (-2); co-authored minimum wage and social pension, voucher and cash aid (-2 to -3), offset by co-authored estate tax abolition and corporate minimum tax repeal (+2 to +3).
